description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {0} due to Mutagen Man, tapping and sacrificing it.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Mutagen ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.
